subject: Guards

subject: Pots

subject: Guy on west side

subject: Dais

subject: Portals

subject: Collapsing floor tiles

subject: North Tower
text: A chest on the floor with collapsing tiles contains a revive.

evidence.quote: Take note of the tiles and then head up stairs. Open the seven chests for a revive, antidote, awaken, mystery pin, shriek, stone cure, and a hi potion.

subject: Follower

evidence.quote: When he gets low on HP, he'll cast bolt, use Grin which confuses one of your characters, and cast stronger on himself which raises his HP.

subject: Follower

evidence.quote: All that you'll need for this battle it constant constant physical attacks from Hero and Aguro, while Lufia heals. Speak with Jerin after the battle to trigger dialogue. When we regain control of our characters, they're in Belgen.
